name: Finn + Emma Organic Cotton Play Gym
description: Crafted from 100% organic cotton and untreated hardwood, this beautifully designed play gym is completely non-toxic and eco-friendly. It features hand-knit toys that stimulate your baby's senses while blending seamlessly into any modern nursery. Let your little one explore and play in a safe, sustainable environment.

name: Burt's Bees Baby Organic Cotton Sleep & Play
description: Wrap your baby in pure, breathable comfort with this 100% GOTS certified organic cotton one-piece. Designed with gentle skin in mind, it features a convenient zip-front for easy diaper changes and a perfectly snug fit. It is the ultimate everyday essential that is safe for your baby and gentle on the planet.

name: Natursutten Natural Rubber Pacifier
description: Made entirely from pure, natural rubber tapped from the Hevea brasiliensis tree, this pacifier is completely free from BPA, PVC, and phthalates. Its seamless, one-piece design prevents the accumulation of dirt and bacteria, ensuring optimal hygiene. Soothe your baby with a soft, natural choice that fully biodegrades.

name: Under the Nile Organic Cotton Soft Toy
description: Handmade from premium organic Egyptian cotton, this delightful soft toy offers a safe and comforting companion for your little one. It is stuffed with 100% organic cotton, avoiding entirely the use of synthetic polyester fills or harmful dyes. Snuggle up with a toy that supports fair trade and environmental sustainability.

name: Earth Mama Organics Sweet Orange Baby Wash
description: Formulated with soothing organic herbs and gentle calendula, this safe and effective baby wash gently cleanses sensitive skin. The delightful sweet orange scent comes from pure essential oils, without any artificial fragrances or harsh foaming agents. Pamper your baby with a plant-based wash that nourishes naturally.

name: Honest Company Organic All-Purpose Balm
description: Soothe and protect your baby's delicate skin with this ultra-hydrating, multi-purpose organic balm. Infused with natural plant-based ingredients like sunflower seed oil and chamomile, it creates a gentle moisture barrier for dry spots and diaper areas. Keep this clean, hypoallergenic essential close at hand for soft, happy skin.
